value.description: The headline value. Absent shows the empty state. Null shows the empty state too, or a dash when the render's null_value is dash.

reference_value.description: Optional value the headline is compared with, such as last week's, shown under it with the difference: absolute, and in percent when the reference is not 0, or as a change under the render's reference_display change. The difference is coloured by the render's better rule, as the trend is. Absent or null shows no comparison.

schemas.title: MetricCardRender
schemas.description: Render of a metric_card widget: its presentation fields, closed.

value_label.description: Optional caption of the headline value. Without it, no caption shows.

better.description: Optional direction of an improvement, which sets the trend's colour: higher (the default) paints a rise as success and a fall as danger; lower paints a fall as success and a rise as danger, for numbers where less is better such as lead time; neutral paints every change in the neutral (secondary) badge, for numbers where neither direction is better. The icon and its accessible name always follow the value's own direction.

reference_label.description: Optional name of reference_value, such as Last week, written before it. Under reference_display change, the words after the change, such as since last week. Without it, Reference.

reference_display.description: Optional way the comparison with reference_value reads. values (the default): the reference's name and its value, and a badge with the difference, absolute and in percent. change: a badge with the direction icon and the change in whole units, then reference_label. A percent value changes by points (-3 pp), any other value by its relative percent (+25%); against a 0 reference that is no percent, the badge shows the icon alone. The reference's own value is not shown.

href.description: The link's target, checked by the shared link rule: https, http, mailto, or a path from the site root (/x, not //x). Any other target shows the text alone. A link to another origin opens in a new tab.

link.description: Optional link at the card's foot.

null_value.description: Optional way a null value shows: empty (the default) shows the empty state; dash shows a dash as the headline, with the caption, the sparkline and the link, and no trend or comparison. An absent value always shows the empty state.
